content: Lexical: dependency-free core engine in package lexical plus a separate React binding in @lexical/react. The newer Extensions convention is framework-agnostic and explicitly replaces the earlier React plugin scheme: defineExtension, buildEditorFromExtensions for vanilla, LexicalExtensionComposer for React, configExtension to override a dependency config. Commands register with editor.registerCommand(command, listener, priority), return a teardown function, and a listener returning true stops propagation. Nodes are registered by getType and extend LexicalNode, ElementNode, TextNode or DecoratorNode.
